item.description:
Changes since `v1.1.20`.
### Added
- **Jira issues** — Connect a Jira Cloud site in Settings → Integrations to see the issues assigned to you in the sidebar's Workspace section, filter them by sprint, status, project, and type, and start a branch or Git Flow topic from an issue. Requires Pro. - **ChatGPT provider** — Sign in with a ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan instead of an API key. - **ChatGPT (Codex) provider** — An unofficial connection that signs in with any ChatGPT account, including Free, to use its Codex usage. - **GitHub Copilot provider** — Sign in with GitHub to use your Copilot plan, including Copilot Free, and choose from the models it includes. - **Azure Repos** — Connect Azure DevOps organizations with a personal access token over HTTPS or SSH, discover their repositories, and list, review, and merge pull requests. - **Browser sign-in for GitHub and GitLab** — Connect GitHub.com and GitLab.com accounts through OAuth in the browser, or with a personal access token. - **Branch cleanup banner** — A repository banner offers to delete branches that are fully merged. - Creating a branch can commit all changes right away. - Push and Fetch toolbar buttons show a badge while those operations run in the background.
### Improved
- Merges prefill the commit subject and description from Git's merge message, without comment lines such as the conflicts list. - File lists show file-type icons with status badges, and row heights scale with text size. - The in-progress merge, rebase, and similar operation banner appears in the main window. - Git provider accounts moved to Settings → Git. - Update prompts include the release notes. - Identical pending push and fetch requests are no longer queued twice.
### Fixed
- Reconnecting a Git provider account no longer creates a duplicate, and adding an account that is already connected is rejected. - Testing an SSH key on an HTTPS account keeps that account's saved token and identity. - The File Status list stays at the top when new rows are inserted above. - Git Flow start errors appear in the start sheet. - Running an older build no longer makes release notes appear again.
[Compare v1.1.20 to v1.1.21](https://github.com/Commit-Plus/commit-plus/compare/v1.1.20...v1.1.21)
